description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractPolicyAdapter which extends AbstractAdapter and implements PolicyAdapter. It serves as a base class for protocol adapters that handle policy commands, providing pattern matching for policy-related paths and mapping signals to adaptables.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class for policy command handlers that extends AbstractAdapter and provides pattern matcher and signal mapping functionalities for policy-related signals.

methods.name: AbstractPolicyAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with mapping strategies, a signal mapper, and a header translator, and setting up pattern matching for policy paths.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a given signal into an Adaptable using the signal mapper, associated with a specific topic channel.
